text:
sara_ml: quick heads-up — ran a cross-quant bakeoff on llama-3-70b for the SQuAD/QA eval set. summary below and a proposal for qprofile packaging so Optimize can auto-suggest.

mike_infra: nice, did you include FP8 / INT8 / GPTQ / AWQ arms?

sara_ml: yep. FP8 (baseline float-matched), INT8 symmetric, GPTQ with 16K shards, AWQ v0.3. metrics: EM and F1 deltas relative to fp32 and median latency per token.

dina_eval: what were the accuracy deltas? any regressions > 2% EM we should worry about?

sara_ml: short: AWQ-int8-hybrid keeps EM within -0.8% vs fp32, GPTQ-16K is -1.9% on tail cases, INT8 symmetric is -3.5 (bad on numeric questions), FP8 matches within +/-0.2.

ryan_prod: are you confident latency/cost tradeoffs justify recommending AWQ over FP8 in Optimize?

sara_ml: AWQ gives ~1.9x throughput improvement vs fp32 at 70-token sequences and reduces peak GPU memory ~30%. cost-per-token down ~45% on our dedicated nodes. FP8 still slightly faster for short seqs (<64) but AWQ is better across the app distribution we measured.

mike_infra: thanks. packaging question: we need a qprofile manifest that encodes quant backend, fallback compatibility, consumer hints, and perf/accuracy deltas so Optimize can compute recommendation score. proposal below.

sara_ml: yes — we should include these fields: qprofile_id, model_hash, quant_backend, backend_version, sequence_workload_profile, accuracy_delta(EM/F1), latency_p50/p95, memory_delta, fallback_to (list), consumer_visibility (e.g. "general","low-latency","high-accuracy"), provenance (eval-run-id).

optimize-bot: suggestion: include a scoring vector for Optimize: score = alpha*accuracy + beta*latency + gamma*cost where alphas are tunable per-customer. store raw components too.

dina_eval: agreed. also add pinned_compat_tags so runtime can auto-fallback to a known-okay variant if a kernel is missing on a given GPU. e.g. pinned_compat_tags: ["rvv-1.1","cuda12.1","aten-cu118"].

sara_ml: here's a minimal manifest snippet we tested:
```
qprofile_id: qp-llama3-70b-awq-int8-v1
model_hash: sha256:abcd...
quant_backend: awq
backend_version: 0.3.1
sequence_workload: {p50:128,p95:512}
accuracy_delta: {em:-0.8,f1:-0.6}
latency: {p50:3.2ms/pk_token,p95:8.9ms/pk_token}
memory_delta: -31%
fallback_to: ["fp8-v1","gptq-16k-v2"]
consumer_visibility: ["general","optimize-recommended"]
provenance: run-1948129999-bakeoff
optimize_score_components: {accuracy:0.82,latency:0.6,cost:0.48}
compat_tags: ["cuda12.1","sm8.7","aten-cu118"]
```

mike_infra: looks good. naming convention nit: use short prefix qp- and semantic versioning for the profile (v1, v1.1) so upgrades are explicit. add a consumer_name field too for mapping to Redwood Optimize rule sets.

sara_ml: updated example: qp-llama3-70b-awq-int8-v1.1 and consumer_name: "search-qa-general". Also we added `recommendation_tier: "gold|silver|bronze"` derived from optimize_score thresholds.

ryan_prod: operational note: when pushing to the qprofile registry make sure the profile includes a compatibility matrix keyed by runtime api (e.g., ServeV2, PrivateVPCRuntime). we had a prod fallback incident last quarter because a profile was accepted by registry but not by private runtime.

dina_eval: we should attach the short eval log and the prompt set id in provenance. that helps quality regressions debugging.

sara_ml: agreed. sample provenance entry: {promptset_id: ps-qa-2026-03, eval_run_id: run-1948129999, summary_url: https://internal/runs/1948129999}.

optimize-bot: automated rule idea: if optimize_score_components.accuracy >=0.8 and latency improvement >=1.5x and cost reduction >=30% => recommendation_tier: gold. otherwise silver.

mike_infra: final ask: can someone draft the registry ingestion CI and the minimal unit test for compatibility? i can wire up the registry hook.

dina_eval: I'll add a pytest that validates manifest fields and runs a smoke eval against a 100-sample holdout. expected EM threshold set per consumer_name.

sara_ml: perfect. i'll prepare the PR with the manifest schema, naming rules, and Optimize mapping doc. dropping the bakeoff artifacts in /mnt/bakeoffs/1948129999. ping me for review. :shipit: 

ryan_prod: thanks — this will make Optimize suggestions much more actionable for customers.

mike_infra: +1, also add a note to the rollout playbook to include rollback steps referencing fallback_to entries.

sara_ml: done. will post PR link in this thread when ready.

optimize-bot: reminder: use `optimizectl validate qprofile <file>` before upload (new CLI landing Monday).
